D1_DDL: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS daily_metrics (day TEXT NOT NULL, platform TEXT NOT NULL, event TEXT NOT NULL, bucket INTEGER NOT NULL, flag TEXT NOT NULL, count INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (day, platform, event, bucket, flag))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS daily_hours (day TEXT NOT NULL, platform TEXT NOT NULL, hour INTEGER NOT NULL, event TEXT NOT NULL, count INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (day, platform, hour, event))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS daily_geo (day TEXT NOT NULL, platform TEXT NOT NULL, country TEXT NOT NULL, region TEXT NOT NULL, app_opens INTEGER NOT NULL, plays INTEGER NOT NULL, play_fails INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (day, platform, country, region))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS daily_channels (day TEXT NOT NULL, platform TEXT NOT NULL, channel_id TEXT NOT NULL, country TEXT NOT NULL, plays INTEGER NOT NULL, play_fails INTEGER NOT NULL, play_ends INTEGER NOT NULL, watch_est_min REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (day, platform, channel_id, country))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS daily_perf (day TEXT NOT NULL, platform TEXT NOT NULL, metric TEXT NOT NULL, bucket INTEGER NOT NULL, count INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (day, platform, metric, bucket))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rollup_runs (day TEXT NOT NULL, ran_at TEXT NOT NULL, contract INTEGER NOT NULL, points INTEGER NOT NULL, rows_written INTEGER NOT NULL, reports_listed INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (day))

refusedBatches.why: a search that carries its query
a network error reported as a stream fault
a bucket past the last edge

queries.metrics:
/* streamloom:metrics */
SELECT blob1 AS platform, blob2 AS event, blob10 AS flags, blob8 AS error_class, double1 AS bucket, double3 AS zero,
       SUM(_sample_interval) AS n
FROM streamloom_telemetry
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-26 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-27 00:00:00')
GROUP BY platform, event, flags, error_class, bucket, zero
queries.hours:
/* streamloom:hours */
SELECT blob1 AS platform, blob2 AS event, toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL '1' HOUR) AS hour, SUM(_sample_interval) AS n
FROM streamloom_telemetry
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-26 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-27 00:00:00') AND blob2 IN ('app_open', 'play')
GROUP BY platform, event, hour
queries.geo:
/* streamloom:geo */
SELECT blob1 AS platform, blob4 AS country, blob5 AS region, blob2 AS event, SUM(_sample_interval) AS n
FROM streamloom_telemetry
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-26 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-27 00:00:00') AND blob2 IN ('app_open', 'play', 'play_fail')
GROUP BY platform, country, region, event
queries.channels:
/* streamloom:channels */
SELECT blob1 AS platform, blob6 AS channel_id, blob4 AS country, blob2 AS event, double1 AS bucket, SUM(_sample_interval) AS n
FROM streamloom_telemetry
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-26 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-27 00:00:00') AND blob2 IN ('play', 'play_fail', 'play_end')
GROUP BY platform, channel_id, country, event, bucket
ORDER BY n DESC
LIMIT 9000
queries.perf:
/* streamloom:perf */
SELECT blob1 AS platform, blob9 AS metric, double1 AS bucket, SUM(_sample_interval) AS n
FROM streamloom_telemetry
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-26 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-27 00:00:00') AND blob2 = 'perf'
GROUP BY platform, metric, bucket
queries.health:
/* streamloom:health */
SELECT blob7 AS stream_key, blob6 AS channel_id, toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL '1' HOUR) AS hour, SUM(_sample_interval) AS n
FROM streamloom_telemetry
WHERE blob2 = 'play_fail' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24' HOUR
GROUP BY stream_key, channel_id, hour
